name: Capture + offline queue
working_tree_note: Report was generated before the final B3 commit and covers the B3 implementation, migration, Edge Function, env example, gate, and device-test fixes on top of base commit ae0d829.
summary: B3 Capture + offline queue is proven 5/5 using local automated B3 gates plus real-device staging and production smoke verification. Device testing found and fixed Expo public env exposure, React Native multipart upload compatibility, and missing receipt_items grants.

environments.device: iOS physical device via Expo dev client
environments.production_metro_note: Production device smoke test used .env.production and Expo dev server on an alternate port because 8081 was already occupied.

evidence: typecheck completed with no TypeScript errors.
expo lint completed with 5 pre-existing warnings and no errors.
scripts/verify-b3-app.js passed T3.1/T3.2/T3.3/T3.5 source checks.
scripts/verify-b3-backend.js passed extract v0 ack semantics.
scripts/verify-b3-db.js passed storage policy and receipt ack schema checks.
Gate generated 5 passed B3 test records.
Gate output note still says official device/manual evidence pending because the script cannot ingest manual device proof automatically; this report records that proof.

tests.description: Capture compresses/orients receipt image to roughly 1024px JPEG before upload.
evidence: Staging storage contained compressed receipt images sized 121382 and 134185 bytes for successful captures.
Production storage contained compressed receipt image sized 143768 bytes.
Client path uses document correction when available, Expo ImageManipulator JPEG output, and durable local file persistence before upload.

tests.description: Default and One-click capture modes enqueue with unique capture ids and preserve capture mode.
evidence: Automated app verifier found default/gallery/one-click processCapture call paths and queue mode persistence.
Staging receipt row capture_id 3908cbef-5687-4a06-a209-4343af63daf3 persisted capture_mode default.
Production receipt row capture_id 718bf984-55e0-4293-af5d-3dd21be14255 persisted capture_mode default.
Camera screen registers Network.addNetworkStateListener and calls retryPending on mount/reconnect.
Queued failures were observed during device testing and moved forward after backend/env fixes; subsequent captures reached receipts/storage.

tests.description: Backend /extract accepts idempotent capture id, uploads image, and returns v0 extraction ack.
evidence: Extract Edge Function deployed to staging and production.
Unauthenticated production function call returned expected 401 Missing authorization header, proving endpoint is live and protected.
Staging receipts rows created with image_path, image_byte_size, acked_at, merchant, total, and status needs_review.
Production receipt row created with image_path, image_byte_size, acked_at, merchant, total, and status needs_review.

tests.description: Ack gate retains local image until server ack, then clears after successful dispatch.
evidence: Client inserts local captured row before network dispatch and only deletes durable local file after markDispatched ack.
Failed extract paths remain pending_extract with attempts/next_retry_at for retry.
Staging and production showed server ack fields and matching storage objects after successful captures.

fixes_found_during_device_testing: Added EXPO_PUBLIC_MOCK_BACKEND support so device bundles can disable mock backend.
Changed real extract upload from supabase.functions.invoke/FormData to expo-file-system native multipart upload because React Native raised Unsupported formdata part implementation.
Added migration 20260722000200_b3_receipt_items_grants.sql because receipt search trigger reads receipt_items and authenticated role lacked table privileges.
Added dev-only queue reason diagnostics to make device failures actionable.
known_boundaries: receipt_items persistence is not part of current B3 extract v0 implementation; the function returns fixture line_items to the client but only persists the parent receipts row.
Swipe-up confirmation currently writes local confirmed state; server-side confirmed edit/item sync awaits the later confirm/write endpoint.
Android device verification was not performed.
This report was generated before the final B3 commit; check git history for the committed snapshot.
